scope: All 51 country editions were checked for route counts, shared map/list data and endpoint evidence. The directory contains 2,366 directional records: 2,266 validated against stored timetable files and 100 published endpoint services. This is selected coverage, not a complete European train inventory.
corrections: Moved six Renfe-feed services to their actual origin countries: five to France and one to Portugal. The provider’s country no longer determines the route’s country.

Removed the suspended Nordland night-service branding and overnight example times. Norway now lists the published daytime Trondheim S–Bodø endpoint route, with a suspension notice for the night train.

Replaced generic Czechia/Slovakia tourism and old InterCity references with named Košičan terminal publications and current ZSSK express-service notices. Published entries still require a dated check.

All 51 maps use the same searchable route list beside the map, with matching directory counts, route-type filters and 50 results per page. Countries without route evidence show a status message in that same panel.
limit: No country is certified as a complete inventory. Published endpoint services have not all had their current operating calendars, mileage and frequencies independently verified. Missing values remain “Not verified”; an empty list can mean evidence is pending, rather than no trains operating.

validation.consistency: PASS: country files, unique endpoints, positive durations, audit/search counts and original dated trip first/last stops, calendars, ranges and frequency aggregates.
validation.limit: Stored timetable validation and published endpoint evidence do not establish live operation or complete coverage of every operator.

layout.desktopAlignment: PASS: same 320 px right column at the tested desktop width, top-aligned with the map on all 51 pages. Sticky positioning and a bounded scrolling list.
layout.mobileBehavior: Below 700 px, the same section is placed immediately below the map.
layout.allCountryChecks: PASS: all 51 country pages, no exceptions
